decision.observation: 12 mph, gear 1, timer 22:50.237, one blue dot, no red X. Car is centred on the gravel, nose up-frame; a firm right bend begins roughly 12-15 m ahead, marked by white posts on the outside.
decision.hypothesis: At 12 mph the car is just under the 13 mph level where any steer has zeroed it, and the right bend is close enough that plain W would run wide into the outside. A 1 s W+D hold at 12 mph is the untested boundary case and is worth trying before the speed climbs further.
decision.memory: The 13/15 mph zeroing events were all at the top of the band; 12 mph remains the practical ceiling for attempting a steer. If W+D at 12 fails, the rule becomes: steer only at <=10 mph, never at 12+.
